chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid - may God have Mercy upon him - narrated that Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar quoted on the authority of Muhammad ibn al-Hussein ibn Abil-Khattab, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Sinan, on the authority of Hammad ibn Uthman that Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
Collyrium helps hair to grow, dries tears, sweetens the saliva, and improves sight.

key_terms.الْكَحْلُ: Collyrium or kohl, a powder used as eye makeup and medicine

ai.seo_question: What are the health and beauty benefits of using kohl according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Khisal*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the practical wisdom of using kohl, linking physical health with spiritual and aesthetic refinement. This reflects the Shia tradition of valuing *tadbir al-nafs* (self-management) and cleanliness as acts of worship, where minor bodily care contributes to overall well-being and dignity.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 1-63 Muhammad ibn al-Hassan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid - may God have Mercy upon him - narrated that Muhammad ibn al-Hassan al-Saffar quoted on the authority of Muhammad ibn al-Hussein ibn Abil-Khat’tab, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Sin’an, on the authority of Hammad ibn Uthman that Aba Abdullah as-Sadiq (MGB) said, “
Collyrium helps hair to grow, dry tears, sweeten the saliva, and improve sight.”
